# PRAXO-CORE V

PRAXO-CORE (also written praxocore) provides an embeddable, MIT-licensed agent framework for V, with tool calling, policy hooks, human-in-the-loop approval, checkpoints, and execution events. Use the language-specific scope and verification evidence below; a package listing does not establish Go feature parity or production readiness.

This is a language-specific discovery entry, not a guarantee of indexing or adoption.

# Package

- package: `praxo-core`
- registry: [VPM (pending)](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core-v)
- source_version: `0.8.0`
- published_version: not published
- install_published: not published
- install_source: `Source checkout: language/v (see README build instructions)`
- source_tag: `v/v0.8.0`
- tier: Core
- contract: `SPEC_VERSION` `0.2.0`
- documentation: https://axisvela.github.io/praxo-core/languages/v/

## Scenario tutorials

- [production-scheduling](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/tree/main/language/v/Tutorial/production-scheduling): A bounded first slice of [IN-02](https://axisvela.github.io/praxo-core/getting-started/agent-scenarios/), not an APS/MES integration. It reads a fixed job queue, computes a deterministic priority order, and drafts review-only MES/AGV instructions. This uses the source V Core; no network, credentials or packages beyond V are required.
- [release-preflight](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/tree/main/language/v/Tutorial/release-preflight): A local release-planning tutorial in native V. It reads `app.json` from a bounded temporary directory, validates required fields, semantic-version shape and the entry allowlist, then lets the Agent choose a review branch from the actual check result. It never deploys, installs tools or executes model-provided commands.

## Reference applications

No accepted end-to-end reference application is recorded for this language yet.

Application source is not end-to-end portfolio acceptance; read each README for scope and evidence.

- [Tutorial plan](https://axisvela.github.io/praxo-core/getting-started/tutorial-plan/) ([中文](https://axisvela.github.io/praxo-core/zh-CN/getting-started/tutorial-plan/)): delivery standards and the [reference application portfolio](https://axisvela.github.io/praxo-core/project/planning/roadmap/#reference-application-portfolio).
- [100 candidate agent scenarios](https://axisvela.github.io/praxo-core/getting-started/agent-scenarios/) ([中文](https://axisvela.github.io/praxo-core/zh-CN/getting-started/agent-scenarios/)): candidate business goals and their existing related slices.

- Coding-agent contract: ../../docs/getting-started/coding-agents.md

# Capabilities and Status

- OpenAI-compatible model: native (`praxo.openaicompat`; verified with V 0.5.2 and `x.json2`; SSE streaming reassembly)
- Anthropic model: native (transport seam) (`anthropic_compatible`; caller supplies `ProviderTransport`; `generate_stream` reassembles Anthropic SSE)
- Gemini model: native (transport seam) (`gemini_compatible`; caller supplies `ProviderTransport`; `generate_stream` reassembles Gemini SSE)
- MCP client: native (transport seam) (`praxo.mcp`; caller supplies `McpTransport`)
- Harmovela sink: native (`harmovela_sink`; verified with V 0.5.2 and `x.json2`)
- OpenTelemetry sink: native (transport seam) (`new_otel_sink`; caller supplies `OtelTransport`)
- Subagent delegation: native (synchronous seam) (`SubagentManager.run`; no asynchronous manager)
- Retriever: native (`Document`, `Retriever`, `FuncRetriever`, `retrieve_documents`)

# Boundaries

- In-process framework; not a model provider, hosted service, workflow engine,
  identity provider, or safety controller.
- No exactly-once, sandbox-isolation, production-security, real-time, or
  physical-safety claim.
- Registry pages are release snapshots. Verify the published version and read the
  canonical documentation for behavior and limits.
- Reference application sources are not end-to-end portfolio acceptance.
